title: Application Runtimes
subtitle: Node.js and Python interpreters that domain applications can run on.
empty: No interpreter of this kind is installed.

hints.node: A major on its own, for example 22. Installed with the n version manager, which needs internet access.
hints.python: The minor form the packages are named after, for example 3.12.

confirm.install: Install version {{version}}? This runs in the background and can take several minutes.
confirm.remove: Remove version {{version}}? Applications still using it must be moved first.

alerts.opInProgress: Another runtime operation is running. Wait for it to finish.

errors.startInstallFailed: The installation could not be started.
errors.startRemoveFailed: The removal could not be started.
